description: Schema for shape text changed event. This is a duration event that tracks text content changes in shapes, batching rapid edits into a single event that ends after 1500ms of inactivity.

shapeId.description: The unique identifier of the shape whose text was changed

richTextStart.description: The rich text content of the shape at the start of the editing session

richTextEnd.description: The rich text content of the shape at the end of the editing session

reason.description: Optional reason for ending the text change event (e.g., 'deleted', 'cleanup')
